provenance.source: Purchased source GLB + native analytic head/seat/guide axes; whole-cam clocking corrected and rear24 lobes reindexed180 cam degrees
notVerified: gas-cycle correctness of vendor cam phasing
corrections: Rear half of each nativecam reindexed180 degrees through circular journal, eliminating paired firing; source lobe shape unchanged
One tappet shifted to actual native seat/guide axis
Valve rigid closed position solved against actual source seat ring
Upper straight stem length corrected to source cam/tappet socket; head radius unchanged
Seven source coil fragments per valve reconstructed as a continuous 3.5-turn helix with fixed wire diameter and native fixed support
Derived retainers added with distinct identities; source has no separately named keepers/retainers
